product.name: Monoprice USB 3.0 4-port Aluminum Hub
product.description: Expand your computer's capabilities by adding 4 SuperSpeed USB 3.0 ports with this aluminum unibody 4‑port hub. Use with a laptop or desktop PC to easily connect external hard drives, flash drives, mobile devices, keyboards, mice, and other USB peripherals. This hub is bus‑powered directly from a computer for use with most USB peripherals. It is capable of data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps via USB 3.0, but is also backwards compatible with USB 2.0 and 1.1 computers and devices. No drivers or complicated configurations are required ‑ just plug it in and start using it right away!Features: 4 USB ports to expand connectivity for computers with limited portsDirectly powered by a computer for instant operationWorks with high‑bandwidth USB 3.0 devices, such as external hard disks, high resolution webcams, camcorders, video surveillance cameras, digital video cameras, multichannel audio, and moreEasy to Install, Plug and Play ‑ no driver installation needed on Windows® and Mac® systemsSandblasted aluminum unibody design for a premium look and durability Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
